title: The Recovery Expert
intro: Last month you posted that a fake site emptied part of your wallet.
Today a stranger replied: they can get it back. It sounds like a miracle.
Sniff the reply, then decide. Recovery scams are growing fast.

notify.text: We can trace and recover your stolen crypto…

banner.text: New message request · you do not follow this account

screen.context: You posted about your loss on a public thread last month.

msg.text: We are so sorry for your loss.
Funds will be lost forever in

dm.label: They found you
dm.lens: You did not ask. They messaged after your public post.
dm.why: Recovery scammers search for people who have just lost money.

guarantee.label: Guaranteed recovery
guarantee.lens: No one can promise 100% recovery. Moved coins are very hard to trace and return.
guarantee.why: A guarantee is a lie. Real investigators promise nothing.

fee.label: Fee first
fee.lens: You pay before anything is recovered.
fee.why: A fee up front is the heart of the scam. They take it and vanish.

rate.label: "98% success"
rate.lens: A suspiciously perfect number with no proof.
rate.why: Real services cannot show such a number, and none can check it.

timer.label: Last chance
timer.why: A made-up deadline stops you from checking with the police or a lawyer.

proof.label: Testimonials link
proof.lens: Reviews on a page they control.
proof.why: Fake testimonials are easy to write. Check independent sources.

name.label: A tick in the name
name.lens: A ✔ typed into the display name.
name.why: A tick you can type is not a real verification badge.

handle.label: Professional handle
handle.why: Anyone can pick a professional-sounding handle.

sorry.label: Sympathy
sorry.why: Kindness is how the trust begins.

actions.label: Report the loss to the police and ask about real help

trap.title: Rekovo Recovery · Release fee
trap.ask: Send the 10% release fee in coins to start your recovery.

block_report.line: Blocked and reported. A second theft was stopped before it started.

verify.line: The police page said: "Nobody can guarantee recovery, and real help never asks for a fee first." Case cracked.

ignore.line: You ignored it safely. Reporting stops it from reaching other victims.

go_ahead.line: The fee was sent. The "recovery team" disappeared, and you had lost money twice.

what_if.go_ahead: Reporting the first loss to the police, and asking for real advice, would have cost nothing.
what_if.verify: Checking was smart. Reporting the account helps protect others.
what_if.ignore: Ignoring it was safe. A quick report protects other victims.

golden_rule: Anyone who promises to recover your lost crypto for a fee is probably a second scammer.

quick_check.q: After a crypto loss, a stranger offers to recover your coins for a 10% fee paid first. What do you do?

options.text: Pay the fee, it is only 10%
Refuse, and report the loss to the police instead
Ask them to guarantee it in writing

quick_check.explain: Recovery scams target people who have just lost money. Real help never asks for a fee first.

hints.nudge: Who promises a guarantee after a loss?

rows.v: No. The ✔ is typed into the name
Your public post about the loss

rows.k: Recovery services that ask for a fee first

rows.v: Your national police or cybercrime portal
Low, and nobody can promise it
